context.transcript:
M
Attention, Lenner's Supermarket shoppers! ® Are you a
member of our loyal-shopper rewards program? Then you
know that this program allows you to earn reward points on
every purchase you make. ®We're now offering a group
membership that you and your family can share. With this
group membership, anyone in your family can earn points
and use them for discounts on future purchases at Lenner's.
The first 100 customers to register will receive a free coffee
mug. So sign up and receive your mug at our customer
service desk today!
context.transcript_translation: 注意，Lenner's超市购物者！®您是我们的忠实顾客奖励计划的会员吗？那么您知道该计划允许您在每次购物中赚取奖励积分。®我们现在提供一个您和您的家人可以共享的团体会员资格。有了这个团体会员资格，您家中的任何人都可以在Lenner's使用积分享受未来购买折扣。前100名注册顾客将收到一个免费咖啡马克杯。所以请今天在我们的客户服务台注册并领取您的马克杯！
